description: This file defines a mock class 'DispatcherMock' for unit testing, which implements either 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::IDispatcher' or 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::ILocalDispatcher' interface depending on a compile-time condition. It includes mock methods to simulate dispatcher behaviors for testing purposes.

classes.name: DispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class used for unit testing, which mimics the dispatcher interfaces conditionally compiled depending on USE_THUNDER_R4.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Simulates incrementing the reference count of the dispatcher object.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a specified interface.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the dispatcher with a given service.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Indicates that a resource has been dropped (only in USE_THUNDER_R4 branch).

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method on the dispatcher with specified parameters, returning a response (overloaded with different signatures depending on compile-time).

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a callback registered with the dispatcher.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the token, method, and parameters before invocation.
